}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:22.619
    | text      = He was a vain, moody man, idealistic and romantic.

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = He was brainy and ambitious and filled with passionate energy.

    | text      = destiny.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}
